message: You know that one friend who panics at the mention of a storm? I love her, but it can be a bit much sometimes! I remember having a chat about go-bags, and while she was all worried and frantically listing what to pack, I realized I had a bag ready in my closet, just waiting for a rainy day. It’s funny how a little prep can turn panic into peace of mind. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm when the unexpected happens?
